findings.claim: The fixing-cors o1 mastery item (plain GET vs JSON POST, which one preflights) duplicates the topic item 'o1 preflight trigger' with the same correct option and distractor.
findings.recommendation: Demand a different discrimination, e.g. a GET with a custom Authorization header.

findings.claim: The cookies o2 mastery item is the published topic item 'o2 secure' inverted; it tests the same single fact by recognition.
findings.recommendation: Combine attributes into one decision: a Set-Cookie line plus an observed leakage, asking which missing attribute explains it.

findings.claim: The environment-settings o2 mastery item duplicates the topic item 'o2 public bundle'; the correct feedback even repeats the topic's companion item about the server proxy.
findings.recommendation: Raise the demand: a .env with several entries, asking which belongs where and what must move behind a server.

findings.claim: The catalog plans this module's lab for the Standard S26 overlay, but the shipped lab README and lab.json notes schedule it on S27, which is the Project day already carrying the graded assessments; the day assignment is contradictory.
findings.recommendation: Pick one day and reconcile the catalog note with the lab material.

findings.claim: The lab claims calling-your-spring-boot-api-from-the-browser#o1, but task 3 only constructs the request description and no test dispatches the POST.
findings.recommendation: Add a dispatch test or annotate the claim as request-construction evidence completed by the course project.
